root_cause: The uploaded 8.8.20.21 hull set SERVER SYNCING on forward Continue but did not call queueCommissionVoyageServerSave after the stage transition.
repair: Forward Continue now queues the exact new-stage snapshot.
Save and read-back each have an 8-second bound.
SERVER SAFE requires same voyage plus exact intended stage on Fleet Core read-back.
Failure terminates as SYNC FAILED instead of indefinite SERVER SYNCING.
Terminal checkpoint state automatically repaints the commissioning screen.
safety: No RLS widening, authority bypass, publication, checksum exception, or project-data deletion.
